@everyone

Release 0.4.2 is now live!

Below are the release notes. We have several exciting changes. One of the first things you may notice when going into the game is that you will be directed to the North America server. As we get closer to alpha, this will help us gather more data on multiplayer by having more concurrent players in the same server, which will help us optimize performance.  We have migrated the NA server to a more centralized region and it should perform as well or better for most of you. Exciting times are ahead.  Thank you for your continued support, and enjoy the latest release.

INFINITY RISING 0.4.2 CALIDO UNDERGROUND

MAJOR FEATURES

---

WELCOME TO THE UNDERGROUND

A hidden new area can now be accessed through a special quest
Enter Calido Underground, ruled by Silas Crowne and the Black Crowne Syndicate
Home to outlaw culture, illegal racing, deadly arena games, and future hardcore PvP

---

QUANTUM RUSH

New team-based capture-the-flag style mode
Protect your base’s quantum beacons
Steal enemy beacons and deposit them to secure victory
The first team to lose all of its beacons is defeated

---
ECLIPSE NIGHT CLUB

Crowd NPC performance test begins
Experience dancing NPCs inside the new club space
An early step toward bringing more world NPCs to life

---

PLAYER STASH

The Modern Building Kit now includes a Player Stash Terminal Chest
Offload goods and free up inventory space while you build and explore

---

SUMMER SALE

New Summer Sale items have been added
If you own new Summer Sale items, check the Nexus to see if they have been delivered yet

---

IMPROVEMENTS & NOTES

Major Fix: apartment building item materials now save correctly after refinishing
Auto Server Location added to the main menu as backend work continues toward Alpha
Reworks to inventory handling, network performance, and transportation systems
Avatar eye resting pose and lid position improved; blinking has been restored
Avatar skin improvements
Dance emote duration extended
Minor lighting, color, and performance improvements
